title: No notifikation for update from 2.8.2.1 to 3.0
symptom: User did not receive an update notification (pink message) prompting update from version 2.8.2.1 to 3.0. On April 21, the phone suddenly showed only LGS and the closed loop had stopped.
cause: The update notification is intentionally disabled for version 2.8.2.1 because it is intended for older Android versions where 3.0 cannot be used. The user was using Android 9, which is newer, so the notification did not appear.
fix: No fix was provided in the thread; the issue is that the notification is disabled by design. A suggestion was made to add a warning for 2.8.2.1 on Android 9 or newer, but no resolution was implemented.
evidence_quote: This is intended, if I'm not mistaken. 2.8.2.1 is only for use with older Android versions where 3.0 can't be used. Therefore the update notification has been disabled.
